import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

# Read the input file
input_df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv')

# Select numeric columns for scaling and KMeans
numeric_cols = input_df.select_dtypes(include='number').columns.tolist()

# Apply standard scaling (z-score normalization)
scaled_df = pd.DataFrame(input_df[numeric_cols], columns=numeric_cols)
scaled_df = scaled_df.apply(lambda col: (col - col.mean()) / col.std(), axis=1)

# Initialize KMeans with specified parameters
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)

# Fit the model
kmeans.fit(scaled_df)

# Get cluster labels
cluster_labels = kmeans.labels_

# Create the city clusters output
output_clusters = pd.DataFrame({
    'city_id': input_df.index,
    'city_name': input_df.index.name,
    'year': input_df.index.name,
    'cluster_id': cluster_labels
})

# Rename 'cluster_id' to 'cluster_id' to match requirement exactly, 
# though the column name in DataFrame is already 'cluster_id'
output_clusters['cluster_id'] = cluster_labels

# Save city clusters
output_clusters.to_csv('outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv', index=False)

# Create cluster profiles
profile_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'cluster_id': cluster_labels,
    'value': scaled_df.values
})

# Calculate mean profile values per cluster
profile_df = profile_df.groupby('cluster_id').mean()

# Save cluster profiles
profile_df.to_csv('outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>

# Initialize KMeans with specified parameters
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)

# Fit the model
kmeans.fit(scaled_df)

# Get cluster labels
cluster_labels = kmeans.labels_

# Create the city clusters output
output_clusters = pd.DataFrame({
    'city_id': input_df.index,
    'city_name': input_df.index.name,
    'year': input_df.index.name,
